title: Plasma Computer Generation (Signature) — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Ionized gas, not silicon, is the working medium; generation is the first piece of the stack. The Signature extension designs wall-less generation cores: the same field geometry that ionizes the gas also begins shaping the containment well, so generation and containment are one continuous field structure instead of two separate stages. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.
capabilities: Generate stable ionized gas volumes from neutral feed gas
Drive ionization by RF, microwave, DC, or laser means
Hold target ionization fraction via power and pressure control

title: Plasma Computer Generation (Signature) — Direct-current breakdown and the Paschen law
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Mirrors its public twin record: Breakdown voltage follows the Paschen curve; air bottoms near 327 V at 0.57 torr-cm. The Signature extension shapes electrodes as field-concentrating fractal points so the local field exceeds the Paschen threshold at a fraction of the plate voltage, cutting ignition energy per cell. This is a Signature-concept extension (speculative): it is an original design proposal for the JAH system, never presented as established physics.

The Signature extension runs a two-temperature scheme: a hot electron tail does the ionizing while the bulk gas stays cool, and the density target is chosen so the plasma frequency lands exactly on a harmonic of the logic clock.
